meta.note: Champions held-item catalog scraped from Serebii. Hold Items, Mega Stones, and Berries are items a Pokémon can hold in battle (held=true); Miscellaneous tickets are not held (held=false). @smogon/calc bundles mainline items with no Champions effect/location text, which is why we source this ourselves.

air balloon.name: Air Balloon
air balloon.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This balloon makes the holder float in the air. If the holder is hit with an attack, the balloon will burst.

big root.name: Big Root
big root.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This root boosts the amount of HP the holder restores to itself when it uses HP-stealing moves.

binding band.name: Binding Band
binding band.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This band boosts the power of binding moves used by the holder.

black belt.name: Black Belt
black belt.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps with focus and boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves.

black glasses.name: Black Glasses
black glasses.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a pair of shady- looking glasses that boost the power of the holder's Dark-type moves.

bright powder.name: Bright Powder
bright powder.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This glittery powder casts a tricky glare that lowers the accuracy of opposing Pokémon's moves.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a combustible fuel that boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves.

choice scarf.name: Choice Scarf
choice scarf.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts the holder's Speed stat but only allows the use of a single move.

damp rock.name: Damp Rock
damp rock.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to rain, the rain will persist for longer than usual.

dragon fang.name: Dragon Fang
dragon fang.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hard, sharp fang boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves.

eject button.name: Eject Button
eject button.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, it will be switched out of battle to be replaced by another Pokémon on your team.

electric seed.name: Electric Seed
electric seed.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Electric Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

expert belt.name: Expert Belt
expert belt.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of the holder's supereffective moves.

fairy feather.name: Fairy Feather
fairy feather.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This feather, which gleams faintly when hit by light, boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves.

focus band.name: Focus Band
focus band.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit with a move that should knock it out, it may be able to endure with 1 HP.

focus sash.name: Focus Sash
focus sash.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP and it is hit with a move that should knock it out, it will endure with 1 HP—but only once.

grassy seed.name: Grassy Seed
grassy seed.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Defense stat.

hard stone.name: Hard Stone
hard stone.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a durable stone that boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves.

heat rock.name: Heat Rock
heat rock.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to harsh sunlight, the sunlight will persist for longer than usual.

icy rock.name: Icy Rock
icy rock.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to snow, the snow will persist for longer than usual.

iron ball.name: Iron Ball
iron ball.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It lowers the holder's Speed stat and makes the holder vulnerable to Ground- type moves even if it is a Flying type or is levitating.

king's rock.name: King's Rock
king's rock.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.

leek.name: Leek
leek.effect: An item to be held by Farfetch'd or Sirfetch'd. This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of their moves.

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slowly but steadily restores the holder's HP.

life orb.name: Life Orb
life orb.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of the holder's moves, but the holder also loses a small amount of HP upon landing an attack.

light ball.name: Light Ball
light ball.effect: An item to be held by Pikachu. It's a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

light clay.name: Light Clay
light clay.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder uses protective moves like Light Screen or Reflect, their effects will last longer than usual.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a powerful magnet that boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves.

mental herb.name: Mental Herb
mental herb.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will be able to shake off move-binding effects to move freely— but only once.

metal coat.name: Metal Coat
metal coat.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a special metallic coating that boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of a move that's used repeatedly. Once the chain is broken, the move's power returns to normal.

miracle seed.name: Miracle Seed
miracle seed.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves.

misty seed.name: Misty Seed
misty seed.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Misty Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Sp. Def stat.

muscle band.name: Muscle Band
muscle band.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband exudes strength, slightly boosting the power of the holder's physical moves.

mystic water.name: Mystic Water
mystic water.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves.

never-melt ice.name: Never-Melt Ice
never-melt ice.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a heat-repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of the holder's Ice- type moves.

normal gem.name: Normal Gem
normal gem.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This gem is imbued with the essence of normalcy and will boost the power of a Normal-type move—but only once.

poison barb.name: Poison Barb
poison barb.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small poisonous barb boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves.

psychic seed.name: Psychic Seed
psychic seed.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain, the holder will use this seed to boost its own Sp. Def stat.

quick claw.name: Quick Claw
quick claw.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the holder occasionally unleash a move faster than it usually would.

red card.name: Red Card
red card.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is damaged by an attack, the mysterious power of this card can remove the attacker from the battle.

rocky helmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rocky helmet.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This helmet damages any attacker that makes direct contact with the holder.

scope lens.name: Scope Lens
scope lens.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder's critical-hit ratio.

sharp beak.name: Sharp Beak
sharp beak.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves.

shed shell.name: Shed Shell
shed shell.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Hard and sturdy, this discarded carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.

shell bell.name: Shell Bell
shell bell.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder restores a little HP to itself every time it inflicts damage with an attack.

silk scarf.name: Silk Scarf
silk scarf.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves.

silver powder.name: Silver Powder
silver powder.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a shiny silver powder that boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves.

smooth rock.name: Smooth Rock
smooth rock.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder changes the weather to a sandstorm, the storm will persist for longer than usual.

soft sand.name: Soft Sand
soft sand.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This loose, silky sand boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves.

spell tag.name: Spell Tag
spell tag.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves.

terrain extender.name: Terrain Extender
terrain extender.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of terrain caused by the holder's move or Ability.

twisted spoon.name: Twisted Spoon
twisted spoon.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic energy and boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves.

white herb.name: White Herb
white herb.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle—but only once.

wide lens.name: Wide Lens
wide lens.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of the holder's moves.

wise glasses.name: Wise Glasses
wise glasses.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of the holder's special moves.

zoom lens.name: Zoom Lens
zoom lens.effect: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder acts after its target, its move will be more accurate than usual.
